description: MainActivity.kt is the main activity of an Android application written in Kotlin. It manages UI components, file selection for importing Excel (.xlsx) files, displays spreadsheet data in a grid, and handles command execution on the active sheet.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity handling UI interactions, file imports, and spreadsheet display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up views, grid, spinner, and actions.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Associates UI components with their view IDs.

methods.name: setupGrid
methods.description: Initializes RecyclerView with a default placeholder sheet.

methods.name: setupSheetSpinner
methods.description: Sets up spinner for sheet selection.

methods.name: openDocumentPicker
methods.description: Opens file picker to select Excel files.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result of the file picker, imports selected workbook.

methods.name: extractUris
methods.description: Extracts URIs from the returned Intent data.

methods.name: populateSheets
methods.description: Populates sheet spinner and sets the active sheet.

methods.name: setActiveSheet
methods.description: Updates the UI and internal reference for the current active sheet.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status text in the UI.

methods.name: appendLog
methods.description: Logs messages to the prompt log TextView.
